entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I bought these shoes and I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you look into that. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, let me see. Yes, it's VF886-01. I hope that's right. The website was a little overwhelming.

No problem at all. Let me pull that up for you... Okay, I see the order for the Spin Class Shoes, delivered about 80 days ago. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

I... I guess it's a preference? They're just not working for me. These are my first pair of cycling shoes, and I don't know, the cleats feel strange on the pedal, and they've been giving me terrible blisters. I just want to get a refund, but I couldn't figure out how. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm happy to help. I'm sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for you. Let me just check our policy for you.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Since you received the item 80 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. So... what do I do now?

It's a very simple process. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to the address on file right now. It will contain a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, okay. That's much easier than I thought. Thank you so much for your help, David.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
